title: 23-Pattern Static Analysis Engine
built: 23 pattern detectors: W01-W06 (Wakefulness), N01-N06 (Network), L01-L05 (Location/Sensors), A01-A06 (Lifecycle/Architecture)
Dual-language support: most patterns use a single combined regex; only class-declaration-based detectors (W03, W04, W05, N05, A01, A02, A03) have Kotlin-specific variants
buildCallGraph() - method definition + call site adjacency map
traceCallChain() - backwards walk up to 6 hops with cycle detection
TypeScript interfaces: FileContent, Finding, CallGraph, CallEdge, ChainNode
bob_reasoning: The 23 patterns span 4 categories with varying detection complexity. Simplest patterns (N02, N03 - missing timeouts) need only positive detection of OkHttpClient construction without timeout calls. Hardest patterns (W06 nested wakelocks, A05 heavy onDraw) require context around the detection site - W06 looks for acquire() twice in the same class, A05 looks for allocations inside the onDraw method body. The call graph builder uses a two-pass approach: first pass collects all method definitions with their file+line, second pass collects call sites. traceCallChain walks backwards using the call graph to find the root cause entry point (lifecycle method).
